[B1] < UserX | 'near' : OldNear , ... > $ UserX 'approach' DeviceX
=> < UserX | 'near' : DeviceX , ... > .
[B2] < UserX | 'near' : OldNear , ... > $ UserX 'leave' DeviceX
=> < UserX | 'near' : nils , ... > .
[B3] < DeviceX | 'buttonPressed' : false , ... > $ UserX 'pressButton' DeviceX
=> < DeviceX | 'buttonPressed' : true , ... > .
[B4] < DeviceX | 'buttonPressed' : true , 'key' : nils , ... > $ UserX 'sendKey' DeviceX | Key
=> < DeviceX | 'buttonPressed' : false , 'key' : Key , ... > .
[B5] < DeviceX | 'key' : Key , ... > $ UserX 'discover' DeviceX
=> < DeviceX | 'key' : Key , ... > $ DeviceX 'bind' cloudA | Key
if Key =/= nils .
[B5] < cloudA | UserY : ('key' : Key , ...) , DeviceX : ('owner' : nils , ...) , ... > $ DeviceX 'bind' cloudA | Key
=> < cloudA | UserY : ('key' : Key , ...) , DeviceX : ('owner' : UserY , ...) , ... > .
